Fastener SuperStore offers a simple to use online catalog of more than 45,000 screws, bolts, rivets,
spacers, standoffs and other fasteners. We sell bulk quantities at great prices. Our parts are
shipped from multiple locations across the US and shipped as quickly as possible, usually on the
same day the order is placed.

Our wide product selection includes 17 types of screws, all available in a variety of styles,
materials, finishes & sizes. Stainless steel options are offered in most screw categories, including
machine, self-drilling, self tapping / sheet metal, thread cutting and thread forming screws.

Bolts, nuts, washers, rivets and sockets round out our most popular categories, while our extensive
collection of spacers, standoffs and rack mounting cage nuts are commonly purchased for use in small
electronics.

Our products are sold in bulk quantities, generally for industrial use. If you need larger
quantities than what's displayed on our site, we can often quote much better pricing than our
already discounted multi-carton prices. Sockets are a fastener line which we can often offer at
particularly deep discounts.

your applications. We answer our phones during extended customer service hours from 7am to 7pm CT on
all business days. Call us at (866) 688-2500 or email us at [[email protected]][38]. We also offer
online chat on our website for quick, convenient assistance.

for the past decade, and we strive to successfully provide that every day.

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in

annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

steel and tested load capacities. Each comes with Strong-Drive® SDS Heavy-Duty Connector screws for
a complete fastening solution that removes the need for through-bolting — so you can build with
confidence.

brings ICC‑ES‑evaluated strength to glued‑in‑rod (GIR) connections in glulam. Its tested formulation
supports high‑capacity, steel‑to‑wood connections while helping streamline installation. Paired with
our complete line of GIR components — including threaded rods, centering and retaining caps,
dispensing tools, and reinforcing screws — it delivers a versatile, job‑ready solution for your next
mass‑timber project.

## Aadsons Engineering


Aadsons Engineering is a leading manufacturer of high-quality fasteners, established in 2012. Based
in Waluj MIDC, Chatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, India, we have been serving a diverse range of
industries, including automotive,oil & gas, construction, industrial, agriculture, and railways. Our
commitment to excellence has enabled us to build a reputation for delivering precision-engineered
fasteners that meet the stringent requirements of our customers. We utilize advanced manufacturing
techniques and adhere to industry standards to ensure the reliability and durability of our
products. At Aadsons Engineering, we are dedicated to providing exceptional customer service. Our

### Trusted Expertise in Aerospace Hardware

Arlington International Aviation Products (AIAP) is a leading distributor of aerospace and aircraft
hardware, serving global OEMs, subcontractors, and defense programs.

With decades of experience and long-standing partnerships, we deliver supply chain solutions that
meet the demands of leading defense, space, commercial, and business aviation manufacturers. Backed
by FDH Aero’s global supply chain capabilities, AIAP ensures critical parts are available when and
where you need them.

### Comprehensive Hardware. Trusted Sources.

AIAP offers a comprehensive range of aerospace hardware, from standard components to specialized,
hard-to-source items. Every part in our inventory is fully traceable and sourced from trusted
manufacturers, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance. Supported by FDH Aero’s
global network, we help keep your operations running smoothly by providing the right hardware—on
time, every time.

## How We Produce?

[Procurement][38] [Asil Civata]

Purchased wire rod is taken into stock after chemical analysis and microstructural control according
to the casting numbers.

[Annealing][39] [Asil Civata]

For products that are hardly shapled by cold forging, it is taken into the annealing process in
suıtable atmosphere conditions. Annealing process is advantegous not only in ease of forming
products, but also for providing serious benefits for the life of consumables such as molds and
punching part of the machine.

[Surface Preparaion ][40] [Asil Civata]

Wire rods with prepared micro structure are taken to the surface preparatıon. Surface coating is
made according to the shaping method of the final product and the type of coating desired on the
final product.

[Rolling and Cutting to Length][41] [Asil Civata]

Before the forming process, the diameter of the wire rod is brought to the desired size. The
products to be produced by the hot forging or bending process are automatically cut to the desired
size after the rolling process.

[Shaping with Forging][42] [Asil Civata]

Products whose raw material diameter and product length are suitable for cold forging are shaped in
multi-station machines. Thick diameter and long products are shaped in hot forging presses. In this
section, the threading processes of the products are also completed.

[Non Forged Shaping][43] [Asil Civata]

Bending, drilling, turning, grooving and similar processes are used for different kinds of shapings.

[Heat Treatment][44] [Asil Civata]

It is the process done to reach the desired hardness of the products that take their final shape.
Heat treatment furnaces are used for 8.8 and 10.9 quality products.

[Coating][45] [Asil Civata]

The coating is the process carried out to extend the life of the products by making them resistant
to corrosion. Hot-dip galvanizing is done in our facility. For other types of coatings, we work with
licensed or ISO 9001-certified partners.

[Assembly][46] [Asil Civata]

Assembly is the process where the nut and washer meet the bolt. An average of 30 tons of fasteners
are assembled in our warehouse per day.

[Sorting and Packing][47] [Asil Civata]

Products that have been assembled are finished and packed according to customer request.

## Hot Dip Galvanizing(HDG)



HOT DIP GALVANIZING(HDG) is one of the methods of protecting steel products from corrosion. It is
the coating of the product by immersing it in a molten zinc bath. Zinc chemically bonds to the
product surface and forms a hard layer. This coating formed on the surface prevents the oxidation of
the steel by disconnecting it from the air. The hot dip galvanizing process is the best method to
protect the steel, considering the reasonable price and long life.

Asil Bolt has a hot-dip galvanizing plant with an annual capacity of 24,000 tons of high-temperature
coating. We now continue to work to put our low temperature coating facility into service in 2023.
With this investment, hot-dip galvanized coating will be applied to 10.9 quality fasteners with
diameters of M27 and above.

the steel by disconnecting it from the air. The hot dip galvanizing process is the best method to
protect the steel, considering the reasonable price and long life.

Asil Bolt has a hot-dip galvanizing plant with an annual capacity of 24,000 tons of high-temperature
coating. We now continue to work to put our low temperature coating facility into service in 2023.
With this investment, hot-dip galvanized coating will be applied to 10.9 quality fasteners with
diameters of M27 and above.

## Research & Initiatives

[A person sits and holds their white cane]

### Barriers to Digital Inclusion 2

Following the [Barriers to Digital Inclusion Survey][115] released in April 2023, AFB conducted a
second study, Barriers to Digital Inclusion 2, to take a more in-depth look at blind and low-vision
people’s digital experiences in real time.

[Read the BDIS 2 Report Now][116]
[Download the Complete BDIS 2 Report][117]
[A man with light brown skin, wearing a suit jacket and glasses with thick lenses, sits at a desktop
computer with his hands on a keyboard. ]

### AFB Introduces Toolkit for HR Professionals and Hiring Managers

In response to AFB’s study last year on the challenges job seekers who are blind or have low vision
face toward closing the opportunity gap, our Public Policy & Research Institute has prepared a
helpful toolkit for HR professionals and hiring managers.

[Read the Toolkit Now][118]

### AFB Launches Research Refresh

AFB’s Public Policy and Research Institute (PPRI) has prepared a wide range of research summaries
and fact sheets intended to convey AFB’s research to a broad audience. These helpful tools are
intended to further knowledge on issues impacting people who are blind through spotlighting AFB’s
extensive research over the years.

# Touch Typing – Learn to Type Faster Without Looking at the Keyboard

**Touch typing**, also known as **blind typing**, is a method where you type without looking at the
keyboard. It involves using all ten fingers and developing **muscle memory** to remember key
positions. This skill is essential for improving productivity, focus, and speed.

Whether you're a writer, developer, student, or office worker, mastering touch typing can
dramatically **boost your typing speed and accuracy**.

## Why Learn Blind Typing?

Touch typing helps you:
* Type faster and more accurately
* Focus on your thoughts, not the keyboard
* Work more efficiently and with less fatigue

No more hunting for keys or switching your eyes between screen and keyboard — just smooth, fast, and
precise typing.

## Key Benefits of Touch Typing

### Increase Typing Speed

With regular training, your **typing speed** can reach 200–400 **CPM (characters per minute)** or
more. This helps you finish tasks faster and spend less time on routine typing.

### Improve Accuracy

Focusing on content instead of key positions leads to fewer mistakes and **higher accuracy**. You'll
produce cleaner text and avoid spending time on edits and corrections.

### Comfort and Health

Touch typing reduces eye strain, improves posture, and prevents repetitive strain on your neck and
wrists. You can type comfortably even in low-light environments.

Take an **online typing test** anywhere — just a laptop and a few spare minutes are enough to keep
your skills sharp.

# Take a Typing Test Online

Practice is the key to mastering blind typing. On **BlindTyping.com**, you can take a **free typing
test** in different modes and measure your **WPM** (words per minute), **CPM**, and accuracy. This
is a great way to track your progress and target areas for improvement.

## Types of Typing Tests
* **Time Mode** – Type as much as you can in a set time
* **Words Mode** – Type a fixed number of words
* **Quote Mode** – Type famous quotes with punctuation

After each test, you'll get detailed statistics:
* WPM and CPM
* Accuracy and typo breakdown
* Mistyped keys and words
* Option to retest with only your mistakes

Typing tests simulate real-world typing with a moving caret, backspace support, customizable
layouts, hand guides, themes, and more.

# Typing Lessons for All Levels

If you're serious about improving, try the **structured typing lessons**. BlindTyping offers:
* **Beginner lessons** – Focus on key positioning and finger training
* **Intermediate lessons** – Improve coordination and speed
* **Advanced lessons** – Practice complex word combinations

Each lesson introduces new keys and builds on previously learned ones, making learning **systematic
and effective**.

Once you've completed the lessons, you can move on to practice and advanced typing tests.

# Typing Practice – Build Real Typing Skills

**Typing practice** modes are designed to challenge and reinforce your skills. One of the unique
training modes uses a **"No Mistakes" rule** — the test ends only when you've typed everything
correctly. Mistyped words are added back into your word list, creating a custom adaptive practice
session.

This method helps:
* Eliminate recurring mistakes
* Build long-term muscle memory
* Push your accuracy and consistency

Whether you're a beginner or experienced typist, regular practice sessions are key to typing faster
and more confidently.

Start improving your typing skills today with BlindTyping — your go-to platform for **free typing
tests, touch typing lessons**, and **typing speed improvement**.

# Welcome to Cherry

[All Products]

[All Products]

Cherry® Aerospace is a global leader for aerospace blind fastening systems. [CherryMAX®][52]
products are the most widely-used blind fasteners in the industry. The Cherry® brand
[originated][53] in 1940 when the Cherry Rivet Company introduced the first blind fasteners, quickly
adopted by the industry.

Our headquarters and manufacturing facility is located in Santa Ana, California (USA). We are part
of [Precision Castparts Corp (PCC)][54], [ Fastener Products Division][55].

Cherry's products are sold across the globe via authorized [Distributors][56], and include
aerospace-grade [Blind Rivets][57], [Blind Bolts][58], [Rivetless Nut Plates][59], [Specialized
Solid Rivets and Shear Pins][60], and the associated [Installation Tools][61]. See our [Master
Catalog][62] for further details.

Our experienced [Technical Support][63] staff can help you select the right fasteners and tooling
for your application, troubleshoot application issues, and provide details and answer questions
regarding [Fastener][64] and [Tool][65] warranties. Tool service and repairs are conducted by
certified [U.S.][66] and [International][67] repair centers.

You will find our [Product Expert][68] online database very useful, providing industry part number
cross references and recommended installation tooling.

without increasing your inventory.

to ensure that the our customers have the right amount of inventory at all times.

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to

[Step Bolt &Tower Bolt Set][130]
Step Bolt &Tower bolt set are fasteners used in the construction of electricity transmission towers
and other steel structures.
[Solar Fastener][131]
Over more than a decade working with hundreds of solar firms both domestically and internationally,
JM is proud to have earned the distinction of being the Solar Fastener Expert.
[Foundation Anchor Bolt Set][132]
JM Hardware® manufactures and supplies L Anchor Bolts (also known as Masonry Anchors). L Bolts
consist of a threaded end where a nut and washer are used for fastening. The L shape, 90-degree bend
creates resistance for added anchoring power. The unique angled design provides remarkable holding
power for tremendous load capacities.
[U&V Bolt Set][133]
Their shape makes these U-bolts perfect for suspending metal channels and duct work. Square u-bolts
are typically used for attaching product to a square shaped post and can also be embedded in
concrete and used as anchor bolts.

# Welcome to MY Industrial Solution Enterprise

Industrial Sourcing & Multi-Brand Supply Partner in Malaysia

MY Industrial Solution Enterprise (MY-ISE) is a Malaysia-based industrial sourcing and supply
partner supporting manufacturers, engineering teams, and maintenance operations across the Asia
Pacific region. We specialize in

multi-brand industrial tools, metrology equipment, PPE, and production supplies,

tailored to each customer’s technical and commercial requirements.


We focus on flexible sourcing, alternative solutions, and responsive technical support, helping
customers manage cost, availability, and continuity—especially for discontinued, restricted, or
hard-to-source items. Unlike traditional catalog houses, we operate with a brand-neutral sourcing
model, allowing us to recommend the most suitable products based on performance, lead time, and
budget.


With experience supporting over 500 global manufacturers and suppliers, MY-ISE acts as a single
point of contact for industrial procurement—making sourcing simpler, faster, and more reliable for
your operations.



## Why Choose MY-ISE

Multi-Brand & Alternative Sourcing
We support sourcing from leading global industrial brands and provide equivalent alternatives when
products are discontinued, restricted, or cost-sensitive—giving you flexibility without compromising
performance.


Fast & Responsive Quotation
Our streamlined sourcing process enables quick turnaround for quotations, helping engineering and
procurement teams make timely decisions.


Asia Pacific Sourcing Network
Based in Malaysia, we support customers across the Asia Pacific region with access to a broad
supplier network spanning local, regional, and global manufacturers.


Technical & Commercial Support
We assist beyond pricing—supporting product selection, technical clarification, lead time
management, and commercial evaluation.


Single Point of Contact
MY-ISE simplifies industrial procurement by acting as one reliable point of contact for tools,
metrology, PPE, and production supplies.


Compliance & Sustainability Readiness
We support customers with sustainability and compliance requirements, including EcoVadis-aligned
supplier assessments, to meet the expectations of MNCs and international supply chains.


## Our Product Categories
* Cutting Tools – Standard and custom cutting tools for machining and manufacturing
* Clamping Devices – Workholding solutions for CNC and precision applications
* Metrology & Measuring Instruments – Precision measurement and inspection tools
* PPE & Safety Equipment – Industrial safety and personal protective solutions
* Abrasives & Polishing – Grinding, finishing, and surface preparation products
* Lubrication & Chemicals – Industrial lubricants, cleaners, and maintenance fluids
